## Recovered observations

62 points (from FC-21) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appc-b11`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: no average curve: crosshatched band 40 to 45 deg; bars at Dr about -.05 to .40 (43.9 deg), .19 to .28 (44.6), 1.0 to 1.07 (41.8); circles at Dr .40 (about 44, FC-14) and about 1.0 (41.3, FC-15); soil 10 excluded from FC-23 per C-1 text
- Codex: Markers and crosshatched band; no average curve. Some underlying tests unidentified; geometry and rate missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. C-21, printed C-43, PDF 157
